metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated MBTA website, searched for 'Charlie Card', found the Charlie Service Center page, opened the booking page at outlook.office365.com, and selected the TAP service. Failed at navigating the calendar to January 2027 (8 months ahead).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate MBTA website, use site search for 'Charlie Card', click search results, find 'Book a time' button on service center page, and land on the Microsoft Bookings page.
metadata.failure_analysis: Estimated failure at step 11 during calendar month navigation. Agent could not find and click the forward-arrow on the calendar reliably, spending remaining turns clicking nearby coords.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to just reaching the booking page URL, which was reliably demonstrated in the trajectory before the failure point (steps 0-6).
metadata.explanation: Agent must navigate from the MBTA homepage to the Charlie Service Center appointment booking page hosted on outlook.office365.com. Evaluator checks the active URL pattern for 'CharlieCardStoreAppointments'. Initial state (MBTA homepage) has URL mbta.com which will not match.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter `active_url_from_accessTree` correctly extracts the active browser URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar, which is exactly the right state to verify that the booking page has been opened.

Metric `is_expected_url_pattern_match` correctly receives the rules dict directly (since expected.type='rule'), and accesses `rules['expected']` without the common anti-pattern of `rules.get('rules', ...)`. Parameter handling is correct.

The expected pattern `outlook.office365.com/book/CharlieCardStoreAppointments` is semantically correct — this is the URL of the MBTA Charlie Service Center booking page, confirmed by trajectory evidence (step 6-7 show the agent landing on this page).
Pattern matching via `re.search` is appropriate: it correctly matches the pattern as a substring of the full URL (including any trailing path segments or query params).
Negative control resistance is valid: the initial state starts at `mbta.com` which does not contain the pattern, so a do-nothing agent will correctly score 0.
Coverage is complete: the instruction only requires opening the booking page, and checking the active URL pattern fully verifies this single requirement.
